note: Item codes are the REDCap field names, melted unrenamed by data/williams_2022_dvmsq.py, and each item's wording, section header and choice labels are read from the same field's row of the deposit's REDCap data dictionary, so code and text share a row: 21/21 fields (1 yesno + 20 radio). HTML in the screening question's rich-text label stripped, its two paragraphs kept on two lines. Option rows: screen 0 = No, 1 = Yes (REDCap yesno coding, which the data follow: 570 zeros whose rated items the deposit zero-filled); rated items 0-4 with the dictionary's own labels. Sections follow the form's section headers: _1 screen, _2 the eleven 'how often do you experience...' items, _3 the two standalone frequency questions (misophonia_overreact, misophonia_avoid, no shared stem), _4 the five 'In the past 7 days' interference items, _5 the three global-impact items. The form's 'sounds listed above' refers to the free-text S2 list, which is not in the table. DEVIATIONS FROM THE PRINTED FORM (not errors, this is the administered REDCap wording): the pool is wider than the published 18-item DVMSQ v1.5 -- misophonia_overreact and miso_imp_conc are not on it (they are among v1.6's 'extra questions'), and miso_fear is printed as item 3 but not scored; the three global items' second anchor reads 'A little' where the PDF prints 'A little bit'. audit_batch WARN (row-count anomaly on misophonia_screen, 1403 vs 833) is the design: non-screeners answer only S1, and data/williams_2022_dvmsq.py drops their zero-filled rated items. RIGHTS: originator's own grant on every page of the form, 'DVMSQ v1.5: Copyright (c) 2022 Zachary J. Williams. No permission required to reproduce, adapt, modify, translate, display, or distribute.' (same notice on v1.6). A PsycTESTS record exists (10.1037/t95328-000), but an express grant from the originator outranks the 2026-09-23 hold rule (RSES precedent); register row written in this batch. Paper 10.3389/fpsyg.2022.897901 is CC BY.
public_note: The wording is the REDCap form this study administered, which is wider than the published 18-item DVMSQ v1.5: misophonia_overreact and miso_imp_conc are not on the printed form, miso_fear is printed (item 3) but not scored, and the three global-impact items' second option reads 'A little' where the printed form has 'A little bit'. Respondents who answered No to misophonia_screen were not shown the rated items and have only that row

note: Each source column's Qualtrics label in the key file is '<question> - <statement>'; the statement is item_text and the question 'How strongly do you agree or disagree with each of the following statements?' closes the instructions. Codes: data/estrella_2023_hypermobility.py renames psq18_<b>_<j> -> psq18_<6(b-1)+j> (a mechanical block rename, so not exempt as a bare column name): verify_estrella_2023_psq18.R shows every source column's 1-5 response counts reproduce exactly one table code, its assigned one (18/18), and every shipped statement opens with the words RAND's printed PSQ-18 gives item n (18/18). Anchors from the key's Values field (1 = strongly agree ... 5 = strongly disagree), which is RAND's printed coding; resp is RAW for all 18 items (the deposit's *_rev copies are not used). One cp1252 right quote in item 2 ('doctor’s') decoded as such. The study rewrote RAND's instructions to refer to care for joint hypermobility ('...the medical care you are receiving now for issues related to joint hypermobility. We are interested in your feelings about the medical care you have received for joint hypermobility.'); RAND's form reads '...keeping in mind the medical care you are receiving now. (If you have not received care recently, think about what you would expect if you needed care today.) We are interested in your feelings, good and bad, about the medical care you have received.' The study's wording ships. RIGHTS: RAND Health's PSQ page: 'All RAND Health-developed surveys are public documents. RAND does not charge or require permission to use.' (web.archive.org capture 20260908183557 of rand.org/health/surveys/psq.html; rand.org 403s direct; sha256 of the capture 6c64ce7a84f19b38b6aef176fabb7c04ad0d83eeb345da314e8e21aa3f067eb6). A PsycTESTS record exists (10.1037/t07124-000) but the originator's express grant outranks the hold rule; register row written in this batch.
public_note: The study adapted the PSQ-18 instructions to ask about medical care for joint hypermobility rather than medical care in general as on RAND's form. resp is stored as printed, 1 = strongly agree ... 5 = strongly disagree, for every item: the nine items RAND reverse-scores (psq18_1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 11, 15, 18) are not reversed, so a higher value means less satisfaction on those items and more on the other nine
